== Summary ==
Five posts from the topic "Have you found Holotable text or image errors?" about the deploy cost of [[Yoda (V) (Virtual Block 2)|Yoda (V)]]: kurtisblow (Kurt Schlichting) leaves Holotable as-is "until the PDF's are corrected" (31 May 2010); arebelspy (31 May 2010); kurtisblow (18 June 2010); JediJer reports the Master List PDF updated (24 June 2010); kurtisblow puts the correction in Holotable (26 June 2010). The posts are stacked in date order with white gaps between them.

'''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=547686#p547686 , p=547713, p=557221, p=561177, p=561559 (posted 31 May to 26 June 2010). Screenshot taken in a web browser on 11 November 2026 (read-only), cropped to the post; the right-hand profile column is cut off unless shown.

'''Used on:''' [[Holotable]], [[PC Legacy Virtual Transcription Error History]]
